name: bld3_mul_pow_prime_of_card_prime_cube
statement: (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ 3) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (a b : G) : (a * b) ^ p = a ^ p * b ^ p
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ 3) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (a b : G), (a * b) ^ p = a ^ p * b ^ p
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_commutator_eq_center_of_card_prime_cube and Mathlib2.bld_center_card_of_card_prime_cube: commutators are central of order dividing p, so by induction (a b)^k = a^k b^k c^(k(k-1)/2) with c the central commutator of b and a; for odd p, p ∣ p(p-1)/2 and c^p = 1 (false for p = 2, e.g. the dihedral group of order 8).
type: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → ∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst : Group G], Nat.card G = p ^ 3 → (∃ a b, a * b ≠ b * a) → p ≠ 2 → ∀ (a b : G), (a * b) ^ p = a ^ p * b ^ p
